run_parallel_gpu_inference: run a binary cfg.NUM_GPUS times in parallel as subprocesses each using one GPU for inference
split_data_range_across_gpus: split a total data range across multiple GPUs using numpy array_split for parallel processing
capture_subprocess_output: capture and log the stdout of each subprocess in real time or buffered mode
serialize_config_for_subprocess: snapshot the current detectron config state as a YAML file to pass to inference subprocesses
collect_pickle_results: load and collate pickle result files from each parallel subprocess range into a list
